unknowns: BELOW THRESHOLD, recorded not proposed: usesIcon — only 4/137 metas name an icon SVG path (input-fields:88, image-block:50, alert:45 by rule id). knowledge/assets/icons/_README.md says the FULL export is still pending a Figma token, so the icon node set does not exist yet. Revisit after the export.

BELOW THRESHOLD: illustratedBy / photography — only carousel and image-block mention photography at all, and image-block's own antiPattern FORBIDS real photography ('SVG rect placeholders only, per the wave-4 DO-NOT-RULE'). _PHOTOGRAPHY-MANIFEST.json holds 251 rows keyed by filename with no component column.

ZERO EVIDENCE: upholds/risks a principle. knowledge/brain/principles.json holds 145 graded principles with stable ids (pr-fitts, ...) and NOT ONE of the 137 metas cites one. A component->principle edge would have to be authored from scratch, which is invention, not migration. Worth Dave's eye as a QUESTION (should metas cite principles?) rather than as an edge proposal.

NOT MEASURED: hasState / hasVariant. 345 variants across 124 components and a full state vocabulary per meta, but there is no variant or state NODE KIND anywhere and no store closing the vocabulary — this is Lane A's node-family question before it is an edge question.

NOT MEASURED: adaptsAt / breakpoint. 16/32 read components carry responsive.rule, but breakpoints appear as inline pixel prose ('stacks below 520px', 'Fixed 360px') with no breakpoint store to point at.

OPEN: `with` (8 entries / 3 components) and `not-with` (9 / 8) are DESK fields with a live resolver (_validate_roles_resolve.py checks 3-4) whose slugs resolve to a meta stem OR a role slug. They are component<->component edges in everything but name. Too thin to propose on their own; they should ride with providesRole.

OPEN: 8 id-shaped strings in metas (ds-020 x8, ds-005 x8, ds-032 x7, ds-026, ds-031, ds-027, ds-030) do NOT resolve against _rules-index.json. Either a second rule namespace exists that this lane did not find, or these are dangling references. Not resolved here — flagged.
REJECTED WITH A NUMBER: conformsTo (component->SC). Already carried as appliesTo in the other direction, 826 of 834 pairs. See the candidate entry; the residue is a 10-pair reconciliation.
SCOPE: this lane proposed types only. The vocabulary is CLOSED by ruling #75 — nothing here is authored, no meta.json was touched, gen_kg_edges.py was not run.
